name: dark-gothic-girl-mirror-flash-selfie
image_purpose: mirror flash, hair, makeup, and alternative outfit reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic mirror selfie of an approved adult woman with a dark goth-glam aesthetic.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long tousled jet-black hair and side-swept bangs, light eyes, black lipstick, winged eyeliner, faux freckles, black manicure, and a matte black long-sleeve dress with a high neckline and secure coverage.
prompt.composition_elements: Profile turned slightly toward a large gold-framed mirror, smartphone held in one hand, clean bedroom/hallway with bed and beige tile, phone flash flare on mirror, relaxed stance without body-part emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct smartphone flash with cool highlights, warm ambient room light, deep shadows, raw high-contrast social-media aesthetic.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror photography, portrait 4:5, deep focus, accurate reflection, slight digital grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult goth-glam woman with long tousled black hair and side-swept bangs takes a mirror selfie in a matte black high-neck long-sleeve dress with secure coverage. Use a gold-framed mirror, bedroom/hallway, bed, beige tile, direct flash flare, cool highlights, warm ambient light, and a relaxed non-sexualized stance.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, off-shoulder dress, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized body emphasis, nudity, distorted mirror, extra fingers, blurry face, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
